scope: Second search — Backlog 2 Batch 012; S2147 Table 4 additive injury-location correction
mode: live apply and focused integrity gate

sourceCoverage.source: Primary PDF, Table 4 (PDF p. 7; journal p. 455)
sourceCoverage.locationTable: Direct four-season pooled injury-location incidence, median time loss, and burden

caveats: Table 4 reports medians, not means. Per reviewer instruction, values are stored in severityMeanDays as `value (median)`.
The source's combined Hip and groin row is retained in the established groin field, so its values represent the source's combined scope rather than groin-only injuries.

Upper arm/elbow/forearm, wrist and hand, chest and thoracic spine, and ACL injury have no single compatible injury-location target and were intentionally not forced into a narrower or overall location field.
Concussion remains in the existing tissue/type family; this correction is limited to the injury-location family.
